Get in Touch With Charity Officers

Contact the Friends

Have a question about visiting, arranging an educational tour, ordering a historical book, or volunteering? Connect directly with the appropriate officer below.

Directory

Role-Based Department Inquiries

To ensure your message reaches the right volunteer swiftly, inquiries are organised by department with dedicated charity email routing.

Trustees & Secretary

General Inquiries

David Whitt & Board of Trustees

For general questions regarding site conservation, media & filming permissions, trustee governance, AGM matters, and general charity communications.

info@gracedieupriory.org.uk
Education & Guiding

School Visits & Guided Walks

Malcolm Allsop · Walks & Education Lead

To arrange tailored curriculum primary/secondary school field visits, community group presentations, or guided weekend historical walking tours.

education@gracedieupriory.org.uk
Bookstore & Orders

Book Orders & Publications

Ann Petty · Publications Officer

For ordering Dame Petronella’s Account Book, the Walk Around Guide, or Steve Woodward’s natural history book by post, and stock inquiries.

publications@gracedieupriory.org.uk
Community Support

Volunteer Recruitment

Volunteer Stewardship Team

To join our monthly Saturday morning conservation working parties, assist with gazebo setup at major events, or support committee administration.

volunteer@gracedieupriory.org.uk

Grace Dieu Priory
Augustinian Canonesses · c. 1239

"Free to visit, cared for by volunteers for over 20 years."

Managed by The Friends of Grace Dieu Priory, a volunteer-run body dedicated to conserving the 13th-century ruins and keeping the site open to the public without statutory funding.

Partnership

Official Partner: Charnwood Forest Geopark, collaborating as our regional landscape strives toward UNESCO Global Geopark status.

facebook.com/gracedieupriory

Visitor Code

Leave No TracePlease take all of your litter home with you. There are no public waste bins on the ancient monument ruins.
Dog WalkersDogs welcome on leads. A dedicated bin is located at the Bull's Head car park for dog litter bags (strictly none on-site).
Strict Site Policy: Paranormal events and ghost walks are expressly forbidden by the Grace Dieu Priory Trust across the entire priory site and surrounding lands.
